scope: Canada annual CPP, CPP2 and EI outside Quebec; Australian full 2% levy only; India explicitly confirmed 12% rate and contribution wage up to INR 15000 (illustrative, current labor-code applicability not independently verified); Singapore full-rate ordinary monthly wages above SGD 750 and age bands.
limitations: No official calculator differential tests or independent statutory approval. AU low-income reductions and surcharge, Indian legal wage-base determination/professional tax, SG lower wages/additional wages and graduated PR rates, Quebec payroll and integrated take-home excluded.
